description: Create a confirmed booking for an existing customer (customerId) or a new one (customer). fixed/fixedCourse products need an eventId from the availability tools; flexibleTime products take eventId or startTime. Pass previousHoldId to convert a hold. Does NOT record any payment. Reversible with bookeo_cancel_booking. Bookeo: POST /bookings.

customer.description: A NEW customer to create together with the booking. Use customerId instead for an existing customer.

customerId.description: Id of an EXISTING customer (see bookeo_list_customers).

endTime.description: Optional forced end time for flexibleTime products (otherwise Bookeo computes the duration) — RFC 3339 date-time, e.g. 2026-10-01T09:00:00-04:00. The offset -00:00 means the account's local timezone.

eventId.description: Slot id from bookeo_get_availability_slots / bookeo_search_matching_slots. REQUIRED for fixed and fixedCourse products; optional for flexibleTime (use startTime instead).

externalRef.description: Your own reference for this booking (max 64 chars).

mode.description: Set to "backend" to act as a manager, relaxing customer-facing limits (time in advance, participant limits, change windows).

notifyCustomer.description: Send the customer a confirmation email.

name.description: Option name, as an alternative to id.

value.description: Option value: "true"/"false" for on/off options, a number as a string, the chosen value's name, or free text.

number.description: How many people of this category.

peopleCategoryId.description: People category id, e.g. Cadults, Cchildren, Cinfants or a custom id (see bookeo_list_people_categories).

previousHoldId.description: Hold id from bookeo_create_hold; it is released on success.

privateEvent.description: Reserve the entire event, if the product allows it.

resources.description: Resources (e.g. a specific guide or instructor) — for flexibleTime products.

sendCustomerReminders.description: Send the customer reminders before the booking.

sendCustomerThankyou.description: Send the customer a thank-you after the booking.

startTime.description: Start time, for flexibleTime products when no eventId is given — RFC 3339 date-time, e.g. 2026-10-01T09:00:00-04:00. The offset -00:00 means the account's local timezone.

name: bookeo_create_booking
title: Create a booking
